title: Cross-Server Arena art, Love Season items, and skill buff rework
summary: This version adds new Cross-Server Arena (PK) art and a rank reward table, three new legendary items for a Cupid's Counter/Love Season event, and reworks the attached buff effects behind Platyputz, Snowkami and Squeezel's signature skills across every level.
highlights: Added new Cross-Server Arena (PK) UI art: arena frames, rank badges, cup icons and flags, plus a new season warzone entrance banner.
Added three new legendary items: Soundwave Gift, Cupid Shard, and Cupid's Surprise, tied to a Valentine's/Love Season event.
Reworked the attached buff effects for Platyputz's Blunt Sense, Snowkami's Wolfy Will, and Squeezel's Water Surge across all 30 levels.
Added new PvE-only buff effects for damage reduction, attack boost, and anger skill effect boost.
Added a new 28-tier arena rank reward table (activity_arena_rank_reward_new).
Tuned the Ruins Challenge power-scaling formulas and adjusted strongest-player and week-theme activity rewards.
